links.outcome: Prospective real-time performance of deployed SVVNet against ground truth
links.effect: In prospective deployment, the model achieved an MAE of 1.33 and Pearson correlation of 0.87 against ground truth during 67 surgeries.
links.quote: In the prospective real-time deployment, our deployed model achieved an MAE of 1.33 and a Pearson correlation of 0.87 against the ground truth.

links.outcome: SVVNet agreement versus ABP-PWA algorithm and other DL models on external validation
links.effect: SVVNet had MAE 0.70 and Pearson 0.92 vs ABP-PWA MAE 1.30 and Pearson 0.80, with lower inter-individual deviation.
links.quote: In the retrospective external validation, SVVNet achieved higher agreement mean absolute error (MAE = 0.70, Pearsonρ= 0.92), compared to ABP-PWA algorithm (MAE = 1.30, Pearsonρ= 0.80) and lower inter-individual deviation.

links.outcome: Robustness to noisy arterial pressure signals, by signal quality index
links.effect: SVVNet was more robust to signal noise than the ABP-PWA algorithm (MAE 4.33 vs 30.87).
links.quote: It was more robust to signal noise (MAE = 4.33 vs 30.87).

screen.reason: The study validates a deep learning model for estimating stroke volume variation prospectively in real-time intraoperative deployment on 67 surgeries, but evaluates model performance rather than testing a specific implementation guardrail or practice.
